title: Consistency—Different Cost Formulas for Inventories
summary: Clarified whether an entity could use different cost formulas for inventories with similar nature and use, or simply because held in different locations or subject to different tax rules. Withdrawn in 2003.

related.title: Inventories
related.relationship: The parent standard whose 2003 revision superseded SIC-1 by incorporating the consistency requirement directly into IAS 2 itself
